clauses.clause: Segment 1: the squad visibly fights (officers fire at infected and land hits; kills not required — at high quality they may be overwhelmed before scoring one); player damage < 100 HP (never a whole life). PO 2026-11-05: "Overwhelmed is the point" — the ≥ 60 % officer-kill share is dropped; the squad may be overwhelmed in the yard.
clauses.note: Personally inspected all41 current ordinary mortal route frames, including attack+1s/+10s and fallback in both qualities: multiple uniformed officers visibly aim/fire, muzzle flashes and tracers reach the infected; raw render.vfx.shots retains actual allied source IDs. Independent fresh mortal segment1 fixture records low122/high31 officer hits,27/3 officer kills,22/0 player damage and0/0 deaths. Both damage totals <100HP. Browser high courier reaches39HP at fallback, corroborating survival with61HP net loss on this different ordinary route. No kill-share requirement is applied (PO removed it).
